purpose: Reduce avoidable verification churn, merge races, and stale-branch accumulation without weakening canonical preflight, PR CI, review, policy, or Product Reality gates.

branch_hygiene.scope: all non-default branches across the five product repositories plus project-orchestrator

classifications.PR_OWNED: open PR owns the branch; preserve
classifications.ACTIVE_UNMERGED: unique current work remains; continue or promote through normal gates
classifications.MERGED_DISPOSABLE: merged disposition is proven and no unique unmerged commits remain; delete-safe
classifications.SUPERSEDED_OR_DISPOSABLE: no unique work remains and disposition is proven; delete-safe
classifications.STALE_VALUABLE: unique authorized work remains on a diverged branch; recover or modernize rather than delete
classifications.RELEASE_OR_HOTFIX_REQUIRED: branch is explicitly retained for release/hotfix use; preserve
classifications.UNCERTAIN: evidence is incomplete; fail closed and review

branch_hygiene.automatic_action: delete only positively verified delete-safe branches; all ambiguous or uniquely divergent branches fail closed
branch_hygiene.modernization_rule: STALE_VALUABLE branches enter a recovery/modernization queue only when roadmap authorization and reconciliation evidence support it
branch_hygiene.daily_effectiveness_relationship: branch hygiene is an operational control reported beside the scorecard; missing branch evidence is UNKNOWN and never treated as clean
forbidden: deleting a branch solely because it is old
deleting a branch with unique unmerged commits
deleting a branch owned by an open PR or active work lease
assuming a merged PR means later branch commits are merged
treating UNKNOWN or incomplete evidence as delete-safe
deleting protected/default/release/hotfix branches without explicit evidence-safe disposition

fast_gate.selection: changed path extensions/prefixes plus explicitly-declared always commands
forbidden: inventing commands not authorized by the target repository
treating FAST_GATE as a substitute for full exact-head preflight
weakening or skipping tests to improve first-pass rate

active_work_lease.authority: live branch/head/actor evidence; never a manual ownership database
active_work_lease.exact_head_rule: an active lease matching repository+branch+PR head blocks merge
active_work_lease.stale_rule: an active lease for the same branch at another head blocks merge until revalidated
active_work_lease.merge_authority_after_release: central orchestrator must still revalidate exact head, required CI, reviews/comments, mergeability, and policy
forbidden: persisting leases as a competing ownership database
using a lease to bypass P0-P4 priorities
using lease release as evidence of GREEN

promotion_failure_classifier.unknown_rule: fail closed; do not infer root cause
promotion_failure_classifier.repair_engine_relationship: classification routes the scheduler; deterministic repair.py remains the lower-level formatter/import/lint repair authority

issue_execution_ledger.rule: Issue comments are the human-visible execution ledger; repository code/CI/governing docs remain product authority.

first_pass_preflight_rate.definition: records with exactly one preflight attempt divided by records with explicit preflight-attempt evidence

merge_race_count.definition: explicitly observed cases where a merge/external completion raced an active implementing or repairing lane

post_merge_correctness_hotfix_rate.definition: merged records requiring an explicit correctness hotfix divided by merged records with explicit hotfix evidence

median_implementation_to_merge_seconds.definition: median elapsed time from explicit implementation_started_at to merged_at across records containing both timestamps

rework_kpis.target_semantics: targets guide process improvement and are not claims of current performance

risk_based_review.rule: risk-based review adds scrutiny where historical cost is high; it never removes an existing required review
